rules.title: Banned unbounded string/buffer function
rules.fix: Use bounded APIs with the destination size: snprintf, strlcpy/strlcat (or memcpy after an explicit length check), fgets instead of gets.

rules.title: scanf-family %s without a width (buffer overflow)
rules.fix: Always give a field width (e.g. %63s for char buf[64]) or use fgets + parsing.

rules.title: Non-literal format string
rules.fix: Use a literal format: printf("%s", msg). Compile with -Wformat -Wformat-security -Werror=format-security.

rules.title: Secret buffer cleared with memset (may be optimized away)
rules.fix: Use explicit_bzero / memset_s / SecureZeroMemory / sodium_memzero so the compiler cannot remove the wipe.

rules.title: Shell command execution from C/C++
rules.fix: Use execve/posix_spawn with an argument vector; never build shell strings from input.

rules.title: Allocation size multiplication without overflow check
rules.fix: Use calloc(n, size) or check n > SIZE_MAX / size (or __builtin_mul_overflow) before allocating.

rules.title: Unchecked numeric conversion (atoi/atol)
rules.fix: Use strtol/strtoul with errno and end-pointer checks and validate the range.

rules.title: alloca / variable-length array (stack exhaustion)
rules.fix: Bound the size or allocate on the heap.

rules.title: Rust unsafe block (requires SAFETY justification)
rules.fix: Minimize unsafe, document invariants in a // SAFETY: comment directly above, and run Miri/ASan.
